core_list_project_teams.rationale: Retrieves organization/project team data using the authenticated Azure DevOps context: `Retrieve a list of teams for an Azure DevOps project`; exact result schema is not advertised.

core_list_projects.rationale: Returns project data in the user's Azure DevOps organization: `Retrieve a list of projects in your Azure DevOps organization`; exact result schema is not advertised.

core_get_identity_ids.rationale: Returns Azure DevOps identity data found by `unique name, display name, email`, which is account/organization data available through the user's credentials.

work.rationale: Retrieves project/team work data such as `iterations`, `team settings`, and `capacity`; this is non-public Azure DevOps data. Iteration/team names and related project planning fields can be authored in a multi-writer project, so output is treated as untrusted; exact result fields are not advertised.

work_iteration_write.rationale: Can change Azure DevOps iteration state: `Create or assign iterations in an Azure DevOps project`; agent-supplied iteration names, dates, identifiers, and paths are stored/assigned in the selected project/team.

work_capacity_write.rationale: Can update team capacity records: `Update the team capacity of a team member for a specific iteration`; supplied activities and days off are written to Azure DevOps.

pipelines_build.rationale: Retrieves private build data for a project: `list builds`, `get status, issues, and report metadata`, and `get commits and work items associated with a build`. Commits, work items, build numbers/tags, issues, and source changes may be authored by repository/project contributors.

pipelines_build_log.rationale: Retrieves build logs: `get the text content of a specific log`; build logs are non-public project data and may contain text produced by build scripts, commits, tests, or other contributor-controlled inputs.

pipelines_definition.rationale: Retrieves pipeline definition data and revisions in a project. Definitions, names, paths, YAML filenames, repository links, and revision metadata may reflect contributor-authored repository/pipeline configuration; exact output fields are not advertised.

pipelines_run.rationale: Retrieves pipeline run data: `get a single pipeline run` and `list runs for a pipeline`; run metadata can include contributor-controlled branch, commit, parameters, names, or outputs, but exact result fields are not advertised.

pipelines_artifact.rationale: Can `Retrieve and download build artifacts`; artifacts are non-public project/build data and their contents/names may be generated from contributor-controlled builds. If `destinationPath` is provided it also writes a local file.

pipelines_write.rationale: Can `queue a new pipeline run`, `create a new YAML pipeline definition`, or `cancel, retry, or run a stage`; supplied variables, resources, YAML override, names, and stage status are sent to Azure DevOps. `previewRun` can return final YAML, which may include private and contributor-authored pipeline/repository content. It queues remote pipeline work but the description does not establish arbitrary code execution on the MCP host.

repo_repository.rationale: Retrieves repository data in an organization/project: `get a repository by name or ID` and `list repositories in a project`; this is data reached with the user's Azure DevOps credentials.

repo_pull_request.rationale: Retrieves pull request data. PR titles, descriptions, labels, source/target branch names, changed files, work item refs, and creator/reviewer metadata can be authored or selected by repository contributors.

repo_pull_request_thread.rationale: Retrieves PR `comment threads` and `comments`; comment content and thread author fields are attacker-controllable in a multi-writer repository.

repo_branch.rationale: Retrieves branch data; branch names can be created by repository contributors and are later usable as identifiers.

repo_file.rationale: Retrieves repository file content and directory listings: `get the text content of a file` and `list files and folders`; repository content and paths are contributor-controlled and may be private.

repo_search_commits.rationale: Searches private commits across projects/repositories; commit messages and author names are contributor-supplied: `Keywords to search for in commit messages` and `names of the commit authors`.

repo_pull_request_write.rationale: Can create/update PRs, reviewers, and votes: `create a pull request`, `update a pull request`, `add or remove pull request reviewers`, `cast a vote`; supplied title, description, labels, reviewers, merge message, and vote are stored in Azure DevOps.

repo_pull_request_thread_write.rationale: Can `create a new comment thread`, `reply to a comment`, or `update the status`; supplied comment content/status is written to a PR thread readable by repository participants.

repo_create_branch.rationale: Creates a branch in a repository: `Create a new branch in the repository`; the branch name/source are agent-supplied and stored in Azure DevOps.

wit_work_item.rationale: Retrieves work items, comments, revisions, and iteration work item data. Work item titles/descriptions/fields/comments are multi-writer project content and can contain attacker-authored text.

wit_query.rationale: Retrieves saved query data and executes WIQL returning work item results; saved query names/paths/WIQL and returned work item fields may be authored in a multi-writer project.

wit_backlog.rationale: Retrieves backlog levels and work items for a project/team. Backlog names and work item titles/fields are project content and may be contributor-authored.

wit_work_item_attachment.rationale: Downloads a work item attachment and returns base64 content or saves it locally. Attachments are non-public work item data and their filenames/content may be uploaded by other project users.

wit_work_item_write.rationale: Can create/update work items and child work items: supplied fields, updates, titles, and descriptions are stored in Azure DevOps work items.

wit_work_item_comment_write.rationale: Can `add a comment to a work item` or `update an existing comment`; supplied `text` is stored on the selected work item/comment.

wit_work_item_link_write.rationale: Can link/unlink work items and add artifact links; supplied link comments, URLs/URIs, branch/commit/build/wiki identifiers, and relation choices are written to work item links.

wiki.rationale: Retrieves wiki metadata, pages, and page content. Wiki page content, paths, and titles are multi-writer documentation content and can be attacker-authored.

wiki_upsert_page.rationale: Creates or updates a wiki page: `Create or update a wiki page with content`; supplied markdown content is stored at the selected wiki/path/branch.

testplan.rationale: Retrieves test plans, suites, and cases. Plan/suite/case names and details are project-authored content and may be controlled by project contributors.

testplan_show_test_results_from_build_id.rationale: Returns test results including `test case titles, error messages, stack traces, and outcomes`; titles/errors/stack traces can be produced by tests or code and are private build data.

testplan_test_plan_write.rationale: Can `create a new test plan`; supplied name, iteration, description, dates, and area path are stored in the project.

testplan_test_suite_write.rationale: Can create suites or add test cases: `create a new test suite in a test plan` and `add existing test cases to a test suite`; supplied name and test case IDs modify Azure DevOps test plan state.

testplan_test_case_write.rationale: Can create or update test cases: supplied title, priority, paths, tested-by link, and steps are stored in Azure DevOps work items/test cases.

search_code.rationale: Searches Azure DevOps repositories; code snippets, file paths, repository branches, and matching content are private repository data and contributor-authored.

search_wiki.rationale: Searches Azure DevOps Wiki; wiki page titles, paths, snippets, and content are private multi-writer documentation and can be attacker-authored.

search_workitem.rationale: Searches work items; returned titles/descriptions/fields and area/state metadata are private project data and may be authored by project contributors.

advsec_get_alerts.rationale: Retrieves Advanced Security alerts for a repository, including `secret alerts`; alerts are private security data and may be derived from contributor-controlled code, refs, paths, dependencies, or secret material. Exact alert fields are not advertised.

advsec_get_alert_details.rationale: Gets detailed information about a specific Advanced Security alert; details for code/dependency/license/secret alerts are private security data and may include contributor-controlled code locations/refs or secret-related content. Exact fields are not advertised.

value_conditions.effect: For that run_pipeline mode, the description says it `returns the final YAML without creating a run`; this removes the queue-run state change for that call, though the tool still has other write/SINK modes.
For artifact download, the description says if `destinationPath` is not provided it `returns base64 content`, so the local file write is absent for that call.
For attachment download, the description says if `savePath` is omitted it `returns the content as a base64-encoded resource`, so the local file write is absent for that call.

notes: All evidence entries are `description` because no source code or implementation behavior is available.

Result schemas are not advertised; output field names are inferred from tool names, descriptions, and input identifiers. Where that affects labels or fields, `undetermined` is set true and the least restrictive applicable label is kept.
Queries to Azure DevOps are treated as fixed-vendor endpoint access, not arbitrary-host SINKs.
